title: Three Winters and One Short Rope
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：monkey　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 monkey 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1995 the herder ① fed the monkey that no neighbour in the pasture would have noted, and he said the feeding was the whole of the winter. The ② monkey, meaning the animal itself and not the rope, ran three winters and stayed unnoted in the book; a monkey, he said, is the only thing in a pasture that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ monkey in that pasture had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ monkey at the far pen, meaning the lamb they kept for the children to raise and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A monkey, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the herder said the noting is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the monkey was the whole of the matter, meaning the mischief and not the animal. The ⑥ monkey, meaning the mischief and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; monkey, he said, is either something you feed or the only word that means both an animal and a mischief. He said the mischief is the part they remember.

By 2000 the ⑦ monkey had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ monkey of the whole thing, the herder wrote in December, was one pasture and three winters of noting; monkey, he said, is either the lamb at the far pen or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ monkey I remember is the animal noted in the ledger, which closed in 2002 and is still noted as the quietest in the pasture. A ⑩ monkey, my mother said in 2004, is the only animal that improves by being noted; every monkey, she said, is a mischief that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the mischief was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 猴子（指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 猴子（指那只猴子本身，与短短的缰绳相对）
C. 固定搭配：feed the monkey 喂这一只猴子
D. n. 猴子（指留给孩子们养的那一只）
E. n. 猴子之事（抽象总称，指一处牧场的猴子之事）
F. n. 猴子（指牧群台账里写到、被记下的那一只）
G. n. 猴子、顽皮（指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 顽皮（抽象总称，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: fed the monkey that no neighbour in the pasture would have noted
The monkey, meaning the animal itself and not the rope
the monkey at the far pen
the monkey was the whole of the matter
the monkey had become a line in a ledger
The monkey of the whole thing
A monkey, my mother said in 2004

answers.why: feed the monkey 意为“喂这一只猴子”，1995 年那位牧人把牧场里没有一位邻人肯记下的一只猴子做了一遍。
monkey 意为“猴子”，指那只猴子本身而不是短短的缰绳，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被记下。
monkey 意为“猴子”，指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一根短短的缰绳。
monkey 意为“猴子”，指最远那处圈栏的留给孩子们养的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
monkey 意为“猴子、顽皮”，指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只顽皮就是那件事的全部。
monkey 意为“顽皮”，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只猴子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
monkey 意为“猴子”，指牧群台账里写到、被记下的那一只，到 2000 年这一只成了牧群台账里的一行。
monkey 意为“猴子之事”，牧人十二月写道，整件事的猴子之事是一处牧场和三个冬天的记下。
monkey 意为“猴子”，我记得的是牧群台账里记下过的那一只，2002 年清点了，至今仍被说成牧场里最安静的一只。
monkey 为抽象总称，母亲 2004 年说，猴子是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的猴子。
